remarks: Tucked away at the end of a peaceful private cul-de-sac, this delightful Cape Cod-style home offers both charm and convenience. Ideally located in the heart of Westport, it's perfect for commuters with quick access to the train, as well as nearby restaurants, shops, beaches, and top-rated schools.  Inside, you're welcomed by a spacious living room featuring cathedral ceilings, a cozy fireplace, and a ceiling fan. The large eat-in kitchen is outfitted with granite countertops, modern appliances, a ceiling fan, wall unit A/C, and beautiful wood floors. From the kitchen, step out onto the patio and enjoy a serene, expansive backyard-ideal for outdoor relaxation or entertaining.  Additional highlights include a lovely enclosed porch, perfect for gatherings, and hardwood floors throughout much of the home. The main level offers two generous bedrooms with plush carpeting and ceiling fans. Upstairs, the primary suite features a private bath and a charming reading nook.  The unfinished lower level includes a washer/dryer, a dedicated home office, ample storage space, and a game room with sliders that open to the backyard. While the basement is not heated, it remains comfortably warm thanks to the furnace located in the area. Must have conf. appoint. need ample notice, tenant in residence.
